name: Madrigal de la Vera (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, black and blue in the proportions 4:1:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Madrigal de la Vera (a bridge above waves and a fleur-de-lis on green).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 27 April 1998 (Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 63 of 4 June 1998); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of three horizontal stripes in the proportions 4/6, 1/6 and 1/6, green above, black in the middle and blue below.

features.role: Madrigal de la Vera arms — bridge above waves and fleur-de-lis
